obernants.operator: Actual Frame.show output parses to scorer GFrames. A two-frame speech/event fixture is permuted with its frame links remapped. Literal role counts stay 9/9/9 and per-link counts 1/1/1. Adding duplicate system quote links contributes predictions without creating more correct occurrences than exist in gold (multiset intersection). Complement excludes dangling/unremapped links and tp>min(sys,gold). Reverse retains all frame detail omitted by notation; correct scores do not uniquely recover source text. Cost includes output bytes, O(G*S log(G*S)) greedy alignment and role/link accounting; no global optimum alignment claim.

obernants.operator: Supplied Items and numbered silver rows compose through exact 1-based batch positions. Out-of-order rows resolve to their original Items; schema TSV transport preserves act classes; metric scores compare the same closed act alphabet. Missing rows remain partial rejection, duplicate rows reject entire batch. Complement excludes position/label substitution and partial acceptance after duplicate identifiers. Reverse loses original row ordering, junk spelling and raw label formatting. Costs follow prompt/row bytes plus ordered key maps and class counts; no model call occurs.

obernants.observation_scope: Named assertions and adapter outputs, not unexecuted process behavior.
obernants.operator: Batches preserve input order within each ascending batch ID. Prompt context suppression requires same source and document and checked consecutive paragraph arithmetic; cross-source collisions or MAX->MIN wrapping do not suppress context. Complement excludes dropped context for those disallowed transitions. Reverse cannot recover source metadata from identical prompt text. Cost is ordered batching and emitted prompt/context bytes; no end-to-end throughput measurement.
